summary: Produced the backend design artefact for ADP-04b at src/design/adp-04b-tenant-realm-binding.md. The design defines additive tenant realm-binding schema semantics, default-tenant migration/backfill rules, OIDC-enabled tenant create/update validation boundaries, repository and service contracts for realm binding and lookup, ADP-04a linkage invariants, and traceability to ADP-04, ADP-04a, OIDC-12, and OIDC-14.

tests_run.name: design completeness and acceptance traceability review
tests_run.detail: Verified required sections (module purpose, interfaces, data flow, error taxonomy, state transitions, dependencies, open questions) and explicit ADP-04/ADP-04a/OIDC-12/OIDC-14 mapping with concrete migration and validation testability notes.
